Class Frontend

java.lang.Object

    • daysBetween

      private int daysBetween(Date startingDate, Date endingDate)
      Finds whole day difference between two dates, ignoring time-of-day.
      Parameters:
      startingDate - the start date
      endingDate - the end date
      Returns:
      number of days between end and start; may be negative if endingDate less than or equal to startingDate; returns 0 if either argument is null

    • rangesOverlapInclusive

      private boolean rangesOverlapInclusive(Date aStart, Date aEnd, Date bStart, Date bEnd)
      Returns whether two closed date ranges overlap. The ranges are inclusive.
      Parameters:
      aStart - start of the first range
      aEnd - end of the first range
      bStart - start of the second range
      bEnd - end of the second range
      Returns:
      true if the two ranges overlap at any point; false otherwise

    • isVehicleAvailable

      private boolean isVehicleAvailable(Vehicle vehicle, Date reqStart, Date reqEnd)
      Checks if a vehicle is available for a date range by checking all bookings for that vehicle and seeing if any overlap with the range.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - the vehicle to check
      reqStart - requested start date
      reqEnd - requested end date
      Returns:
      true if no existing booking for the vehicle overlaps the range; false otherwise

    • isVehicleAvailableSelf

      private boolean isVehicleAvailableSelf(Date reqStart, Date reqEnd, String employee)
      Checks if the employee has any of their own bookings that overlap a date range. Used to prevent self conflicts.
      Parameters:
      reqStart - requested start date
      reqEnd - requested end date
      employee - the employee name to match against bookings
      Returns:
      true if the employee has no overlapping bookings; false otherwise

      private void moveFromReservationToTripList(Booking originalBooking, int originalMileage, int currentMileage)
      Moves a completed reservation into the trip list. Removes the booking from reservations, then updates vehicle mileage.

      originalBooking - the completed booking

    • findIndexOfEarliestEndDate

      private int findIndexOfEarliestEndDate(Booking booking)
      Finds the index (in reservation) of the booking for the same vehicle whose end date is earliest.
      Parameters:
      booking - a reference booking used for matching
      Returns:
      the index of the earliest ending booking for that vehicle; -1 if none is found

    • bookVehicleDateChecks

      private boolean bookVehicleDateChecks(String[] parts, Date startingDate, Date endingDate, Date today, Date threeMonthsFromToday)
      Checks requested booking dates against rules: Prints a specific error message and returns false on the first violation.
      Parameters:
      parts - tokenized input
      startingDate - requested start date
      endingDate - requested end date
      today - today's date
      threeMonthsFromToday - the date three months from today
      Returns:
      true if all checks pass; false otherwise (and will print error message)
